works.title: Trump's Credit Card Rate Cap: Economic Crash and Jubilee Solution
works.description: A policy analysis piece examining how Trump's proposed 10% cap on credit card rates will trigger a cascading credit crunch and depression through forced credit line reductions and collapsing asset valuations. The post proposes a David Graeber Jubilee-based wholesale debt cancellation as a deleveraging solution.
works.quote: I am writing a post about the credit crunch that Donald Trump's 10% cap on credit card rates will create.
